instructions: Pull the skin off the chicken and shred 2 1/2 cups of the meat with your fingers. Save the rest of the chicken for another meal.
Thinly slice the onion, dice the bell pepper and mince the 2 garlic cloves. Chop about 1/2 cup of the cilantro leaves.
Put 1 cup of the corn in a sieve, run warm water over it for a minute to thaw it, and shake it dry.
In a small bowl, mix the 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp paprika, 1/2 tsp onion powder, 1/2 tsp oregano, 1/2 tsp salt and 1/8 tsp pepper.

Heat the 1 1/2 tbsp olive oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium high. Add the onion and cook for about 3 minutes, stirring now and then, until it's soft and browned at the edges. Add the bell pepper and cook for 1 minute.

Add the garlic and the spice mix and stir for 30 seconds, until it smells fragrant. Add the chicken and the corn and stir for 2 minutes, until the chicken is hot and coated in the spices. Transfer it all into a bowl and wipe out the pan.

Lay out the 4 tortillas. Sprinkle 1/4 cup of the cheese over one half of each tortilla, top it with a quarter of the chicken and a quarter of the cilantro, then another 1/4 cup of the cheese. Fold the bare half over and press down lightly.
Set the pan over medium low with no oil. Put in 2 of the quesadillas, press them down lightly and cover the pan with a lid. Cook for 3 minutes, until the underside is deep golden and crisp.
Flip them carefully over the folded edge and cook the other side for 3 minutes with the lid off, until it's crisp and the cheese has melted. Move them to a board and cook the other 2 the same way.
Cut each quesadilla into 3 wedges. Serve with the sour cream and salsa.
method_notes: Both cook flour tortilla quesadillas in a nonstick pan with no oil until crisp on each side. RecipeTin Eats seasons the chicken with a spice mix of cumin, paprika, onion powder, oregano and salt, cooks onion, garlic and red pepper first, and layers the filling with corn, coriander and Monterey Jack, covering the pan for the first side; this version follows it with leftover cooked chicken warmed through the spices instead of raw thighs. Gimme Delicious stirs shredded cooked chicken with sour cream, cheddar, garlic powder and cilantro and sandwiches it between two tortillas, 2 minutes a side.
